tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yon tan rgya mtsho ma'i tshig don gyi dogs gcod ma rig mun sel bzhugs so// na mo ba dī sha ya/ smra ba'i dbang por rab btud nas/ /smra mkhas gzhung brgya 'dzin pa 'gas/ /smras pa'am tshig don 'ga' zhig la/ /smra ba'i the tshom 'di ltar snang / /shing gi sdong po che rnams kyang / /'khri shing drwa bas rab bcing tshe/ /yongs rdzogs skye ba'i gegs byed ltar/ /srid par 'ching ba'i drwa ba rnams/ /dral zhes bya ba bcad pa'i don/ /bral bar 'chad pa sgra don nor/ /yon tan rgya mtsho byang sems te/ /zhi lam gnas pa rang rgyal yin/ /mchog sgrogs nyan thos 'phags pa'i ming / /rkang gnyis dbang po zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas mtshan yin rkang gnyis pa/ /mi yi ming yin dbang po ni/ /de yi mchog la de skad brjod/ /des na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi/ /go 'phang dam pa mngon gyur pas/ /gdul bya rigs can gsum ka yang / /de dang de la 'god mdzad pa/ /srid zhi kun las legs par rgyal/ /'di ni phul byung rgyan du 'dod/ /de ltar yin phyir mchog bgrod dang / /rgyu'am rkang pa don gnyis la/ /sbyar te 'chad pa legs bshad min/ /'gro ba'i bla ma thub dbang yin/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs la mi 'thad/ /khums zhes bya ba thos pa'i ming / /de la blo 'khum zhes pa 'khrul/ /bku zhes bya ba bro ba'i don/ /ji ltar mnams na rab bku la/ /zhes dang mtshungs mod bkru zhes shing / /grang zhes bya ba de tsam zad/ /ces pa'i don yin drang po zhes/ /bshad pa'ang yi ge'i brda ma dag /srid gsum bla ma sangs rgyas yin/ /de yang 'phral te 'chad pa 'khrul/ /gzhan yang dpe ma dag pa yi/ /dogs pa'i gnas ni kha cig 'dug /re shig 'di tsam kho nas kyang / /brtag dpyad bya ba'i yul du 'gyur/ /de ltar rtsom po rang nyid la/ /'thad dam mi 'thad legs par dris/ /blo chung kha cig rang blo yi/ /rmongs zhen phyogs 'dzin byed de mtshar/ /kho bos 'di ltar brtsams pa yang /

/mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs mang mthong zhing / /tshig don shes nas bris pa yin/ /phrag dog 'gran sems ga na srid/ /ma go'i cal col ma snga bar/ /mkhas la gtugs nas rtogs par rigs/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsā bas/ /ma rig mun sel 'di brtsams pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun shes rab kyis/ /rta ljang snang ba rgyas par shog /sarb+ba dī she ṣu pra shanti pa bistā ra sya ma hā dhiṣṭha nantu// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma'i tshig don gyi dogs chod ma rig mun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
